001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats events as logfmt, one line of key=value pairs per event like Go's log/slog
009 * text handler, selected with the logfmt encoder scheme.
010 * <p>
011 * Each event is written as one line, for example:
012 * <code>time=2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z level=INFO logger=com.example.App threadId=1 threadName=main message="hello world" requestId=42</code>
013 * <ul>
014 * <li>The thread fields are chosen with {@link ThreadFields}, by default
015 * <code>threadId</code> and <code>threadName</code>.</li>
016 * <li><code>time</code> is the UTC instant with milliseconds.</li>
017 * <li><code>level</code> is written by the level formatter, by default
018 * <code>TRACE</code>, <code>DEBUG</code>, <code>INFO</code>, <code>WARN</code>, or
019 * <code>ERROR</code>. logfmt does not define level names, and tools differ (Go's slog
020 * is upper case, logrus lower case).</li>
021 * <li>Every key value follows <code>message</code>, in order. A key value named like
022 * one of these fields is prefixed with <code>keyValues.</code>.</li>
023 * <li>A throwable adds <code>error</code> (its <code>toString()</code>) and
024 * <code>stacktrace</code>.</li>
025 * </ul>
026 * A value is quoted when it is empty or contains a space, <code>=</code>,
027 * <code>"</code>, or a control character. Inside quotes <code>"</code>,
028 * <code>\</code>, newline, carriage return, and tab are backslash escaped and other
029 * control characters are written as <code>\</code><code>uXXXX</code>, so every event
030 * stays on one line. Characters logfmt does not allow in keys, and <code>%</code>,
031 * are percent-encoded (<code>a b</code> is <code>a%20b</code>), and an empty key is
032 * <code>%</code>, so different keys stay different.
033 * <p>
034 * Values can be colored like the TTLL formatter; keys, <code>message</code>,
035 * <code>error</code>, and <code>stacktrace</code> are not. Padding from a padding
036 * level formatter is written after the level's color.
037 * <table class="table">
038 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
039 * <tr>
040 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
041 * <th>Type</th>
042 * <th>Required</th>
043 * <th>Default</th>
044 * <th>Description</th>
045 * </tr>
046 * <tr>
047 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.levelFormatter" }</code></td>
048 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
049 * <td><code>true</code></td>
050 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter#of() level_formatter}</td>
051 * <td>Level formatter; as a property, a level formatter constant name.</td>
052 * </tr>
053 * <tr>
054 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.thread" }</code></td>
055 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
056 * <td><code>true</code></td>
057 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}</td>
058 * <td>Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.</td>
059 * </tr>
060 * <tr>
061 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.color" }</code></td>
062 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
063 * <td><code>false</code></td>
064 * <td><code>null</code></td>
065 * <td>Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
066 * </tr>
067 * <tr>
068 * <td><code>{@index "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.theme" }</code></td>
069 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
070 * <td><code>false</code></td>
071 * <td><code>null</code></td>
072 * <td>Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
073 * </tr>
074 * </table>
075 */
076public final class LogfmtFormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<LogfmtFormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
077
078        /**
079         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
080         * this prefix.
081         */
082        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.";
083        
084        /**
085         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_levelFormatter } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter</code> Level formatter; as a property, a level formatter constant name.
086         */
087        static final String PROPERTY_levelFormatter = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "levelFormatter";
088        /**
089         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
090         */
091        static final String PROPERTY_thread = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "thread";
092        /**
093         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
094         */
095        static final String PROPERTY_color = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "color";
096        /**
097         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
098         */
099        static final String PROPERTY_theme = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "theme";
100        
101        private final String propertyPrefix;
102        final String property_levelFormatter;
103        final String property_thread;
104        final String property_color;
105        final String property_theme;
106        
107        private final java.lang.String name;
108        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter levelFormatter = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.DEFAULT_LEVEL_FORMATTER;
109        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields.BOTH;
110        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color = null;
111        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme = null;
112        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;
113        
114        /**
115         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
116         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.logfmt.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
117         */
118        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder(
119                        java.lang.String name
120                        ) {
121                try {
122                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
123                                        "name", name
124                                );
125                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
126                        this.name = name;
127                        property_levelFormatter = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_levelFormatter, prefixParameters);
128                        property_thread = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_thread, prefixParameters);
129                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
130                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
131                }
132                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
133                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
134                }
135        }
136
137
138        /**
139         * Sets serviceRegistry.
140         * Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
141         * Default is <code>null</code>.
142         * @param serviceRegistry not configurable through properties Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
143         * @return this builder.
144         */
145        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder serviceRegistry(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
146                this.serviceRegistry = serviceRegistry;
147                return this;
148        }
149
150        
151        /**
152         * Sets <strong>required</strong> levelFormatter.
153         * Level formatter; as a property, a level formatter constant name.
154         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter#of() level_formatter}.
155         * @param levelFormatter <code>{@value #PROPERTY_levelFormatter } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter</code> Level formatter; as a property, a level formatter constant name.
156         * @return this builder.
157         */
158        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder levelFormatter(io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter levelFormatter) {
159                this.levelFormatter = levelFormatter;
160                return this;
161        }
162        
163        /**
164         * Sets <strong>required</strong> thread.
165         * Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
166         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields#BOTH both}.
167         * @param thread <code>{@value #PROPERTY_thread } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields</code> Which thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
168         * @return this builder.
169         */
170        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder thread(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.ThreadFields thread) {
171                this.thread = thread;
172                return this;
173        }
174        
175        /**
176         * Sets color.
177         * Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
178         * Default is <code>null</code>.
179         * @param color <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> Whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
180         * @return this builder.
181         */
182        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder color(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color) {
183                this.color = color;
184                return this;
185        }
186        
187        /**
188         * Sets theme.
189         * Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
190         * Default is <code>null</code>.
191         * @param theme <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> Which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
192         * @return this builder.
193         */
194        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder theme(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme) {
195                this.theme = theme;
196                return this;
197        }
198        
199        /**
200         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter } from this builder.
201         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
202         */
203        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter build() {
204                try {
205                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.of(
206                                        this.name
207                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_levelFormatter, this.levelFormatter)
208                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_thread, this.thread)
209                                        , this.color
210                                        , this.theme
211                                        , this.serviceRegistry
212                                        );
213                }
214                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
215                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
216                }
217        }
218        
219        @Override
220        public LogfmtFormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
221                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
222                var _levelFormatter = properties.forKey(property_levelFormatter).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.convertLevelFormatter(_v)).or(this.levelFormatter).validate(__v);
223                var _thread = properties.forKey(property_thread).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.convertThread(_v)).or(this.thread).validate(__v);
224                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
225                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
226                __v.validate();
227                this.levelFormatter = _levelFormatter.value();
228                this.thread = _thread.value();
229                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
230                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
231                return this;
232        }
233        
234        /**
235         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
236         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
237         */
238        @Override
239        public String propertyPrefix() {
240                return this.propertyPrefix;
241        }
242        
243}
